description: Before you deal with someone you do not know: who is behind a domain, a url, an email, a wallet or an agent. Answers the company Alion knows there (its card, whether it hires, when its site last answered, whether it is claimed), the agents registered for it, red flags (sanctions lists, a lookalike of a known company's domain, a public mail domain, a blocked agent) and a verdict - known_active, known_quiet, agent_known, unknown, sanctioned, lookalike, agent_blocked - with the evidence it rests on. An observation on the date, not a guarantee. Free. Docs: https://alion.io/developers/docs

target.description: A domain ("acme.com"), a url (a site, an MCP or A2A endpoint), an email, a wallet address (0x... or Solana) or an agent's handle.
